name: model_op_topk
description: SGLang MoE top-k gating (sgl_kernel.topk_softmax, used by sglang/srt/layers/moe/topk.py fused_topk). In-place: gating_output [num_tokens, num_experts] float32/float16/bfloat16 is softmaxed in float32, then the top-k experts per token are written into the preallocated topk_weights [num_tokens, topk] float32 and topk_ids [num_tokens, topk] int32 buffers. When renormalize is true the selected weights are divided by their sum. Values are ordered by descending weight (torch.topk order), not by expert id. Returns None.
